answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 146946 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Alhamdulillah, I am blessed with a baby boy last week and thought to keep his name as Shahzain, so kindly request you to give us your valuable advice and suggestions for this name or else if possible suggest us good baby boy names. Question: Alhamdulillah, I am blessed with a baby boy last week and thought to keep his name as Shahzain, so kindly request you to give us your valuable advice and suggestions for this name or else if possible suggest us good baby boy names. Answer ID: 146946 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 313/278/L=3/1438) Zain means adornment. It is allowed to keep this name. However, if you add Deen or Islam with it and keep the name Zainuddin or Zainul Islam then it shall be better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
